name: Personality
description: Getting tired of claudes banal responses, well wait no more. Personality brings some enjoyment back to just entering 1, 2 or 3. Now you can laugh at loud all while consuming the worlds resources for questionable outcomes.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `personality`.

Installs with `claude plugin install personality@claude-community` from `nickmerrett/personality`.

27 character modes for Claude Code. Same technical accuracy. Wildly different vibes.

Getting tired of claudes banal responses, well wait no more. Personality brings some enjoyment back to just entering 1, 2 or 3. Now you can laugh at loud all while consuming the worlds resources for questionable outcomes.
